findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?registry=mcpregistry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: resolve_deep_point, get_loc_id_info, compare_geographies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_catalog · Public sink: resolve_deep_point, get_loc_id_info, compare_geographies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
